name: Charm Crush
desc: Open-source terminal coding agent with its own TUI
desc_zh: 带自研 TUI 的开源终端编程智能体
solves: Keeps a fast agent loop entirely in the terminal, with no editor to configure.
solves_zh: 整个循环都在终端里，不用配编辑器。
best_for: You live in the shell and want an agent that stays there.
best_for_zh: 平时就待在 shell 里、想让智能体也待在终端时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：Coding-agent gap check against the existing catalogue。来源：https://charm.land/
